name: Mortal Kombat: Armageddon — Shujinko Biography
notes: Official in-game biography accessed through the MKWarehouse preservation mirror. It confirms Onaga was defeated by Shujinko's assault; after Onaga's body collapsed it reverted to the lifeless shape of Reptile, establishing Reptile as the host body. Shujinko also states that he had allowed Onaga to return. Its wording about purging Onaga's soul is not modeled as soul destruction because Onaga's own Armageddon biography later describes that soul as bound in the Netherrealm.
